blocks.text: SQLite是Python内置的轻量级数据库，无需安装即可使用。使用sqlite3模块操作。

blocks.code:
import sqlite3

# 连接数据库（不存在则创建）
conn = sqlite3.connect('mydb.db')
cursor = conn.cursor()

# 创建表
cursor.execute('''
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        age INTEGER
    )
''')

# 插入数据
cursor.execute('INSERT INTO users (name, age) VALUES (?, ?)', ('Alice', 25))
conn.commit()

# 查询数据
cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM users')
for row in cursor.fetchall():
    print(row)

conn.close()

blocks.question: commit()的作用是什么？
blocks.explain: commit()提交事务，保存对数据库的更改

conn = sqlite3.connect('test.db')
c = conn.cursor()

c.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, price REAL)')

c.execute('INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, "iPhone", 999.99)')
conn.commit()

c.execute('SELECT * FROM products')

blocks.title: 项目：学生管理系统
blocks.code:
import sqlite3

class StudentDB:
    def __init__(self, db_name='students.db'):
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(db_name)
        self.c = self.conn.cursor()
        self.c.execute('''
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS students (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                name TEXT,
                grade INTEGER
            )
        ''')
    
    def add_student(self, name, grade):
        self.c.execute('INSERT INTO students (name, grade) VALUES (?, ?)', (name, grade))
        self.conn.commit()
    
    def get_all(self):
        self.c.execute('SELECT * FROM students')
        return self.c.fetchall()
    
    def close(self):
        self.conn.close()

db = StudentDB()
db.add_student('Alice', 90)
db.add_student('Bob', 85)
print(db.get_all())
db.close()
